Completion — saved work/control: StopAll now waits per agent on persistenceDone, closed exactly once by closePersistence on every onTransportClosed path (stopComplete, stopped, crash); agents enter c.agents only after the transport loop exists, so no waiter lacks a closer, and the wait is bounded by the server's single 5 s shutdown context (which also covers quiesce, provider StopGrace and HTTP shutdown). 07bc14f6's WithoutCancel Switch runs teardown/start/rollback to an outcome; shutdown quiesce still bounds it. Fork is tri-state: pre-change snapshots stored an explicit boolean and decode unchanged; only empty/malformed/reindexed '{}' rows become unknown, which Clone/Edit refuse with 422 fork_support_unknown rather than forking; live negotiation always writes an explicit value; openFork uses CanFork. Terminal StopAll transcript-close parity stays owned by the live J3 item. Limits: slow-exiting providers can still exhaust the shared 5 s budget before the close is recorded (unmeasured).

CLI dashboardPort fails closed without this home's live pidfile; every dashboard start (foreground, detached child) writes it, and agent children inherit the server environment and hence CHUCK_HOME, so agent-run operator commands reach the same dashboard. Unknown-subcommand/positional refusals are usage errors, not effects.

Package text matches FS-11.R11-R16 and FS-01.R60-R61; only index.html is tracked and assemble.sh rebuilds dist.
